sam (docs): heads-up: staging linkcheck showing a bunch of 404s for in-page anchors after the docusaurus bump. looks like headings with parentheses or inline code lost their slugs.
josh (eng): can you paste a concrete example?
sam (docs): sure: `guides/ops#grpc-endpoints-(beta)` is linked from the nav but built page has no `#grpc-endpoints-beta` or encoded variant. the generator appears to strip parentheses and the token inside, so link target doesn't match.
markdown-lint-bot: Notice: header "gRPC endpoints (beta)" in docs/guides/ops.md lacks an explicit id.
josh (eng): ok — short term we can add explicit header ids in markdown. e.g. `## gRPC endpoints (beta) {#grpc-endpoints-beta}`.
sam (docs): yeah i started a grep: `grep -R "(beta)\|`" docs/ | wc -l` shows ~18 headings with parentheses/inline code. i'm fine with adding ids where it matters.
josh (eng): longer term: our docusaurus slugify config should match the older behavior. i'll open an issue to pin slugify plugin behavior.
sam (docs): can we automate the quick patch? i'll open a small PR that adds explicit ids to the 6 failing pages so we can un-break the site this morning.
josh (eng): suggest a tiny python script to insert ids when the heading contains parenthesis or backticks and no existing id. here's a quick one-liner: `python -c "import sys,re;print(re.sub(r'^(##?\s+.+?)(\n)', lambda m: m.group(1)+(' {#'+re.sub('[^a-z0-9-]','-',m.group(1).lower())+'}' if '{#' not in m.group(1) else '')+'\n', sys.stdin.read(), flags=re.M))" < file.md > out.md`
sam (docs): nice. i'll avoid the one-liner complexity in the PR and instead add explicit ids manually for the 6 pages (less risky).
ci-bot: linkcheck job re-run queued on branch docs/fix-explicit-ids (job #318).
sam (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/495 — manual ids + short note in the PR about adding a follow-up to align slugify. assigning @josh for review.
josh (eng): reviewing now. also created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/206 "Docusaurus slugify parity after upgrade" to track the proper fix.
sam (docs): perfect. i'll merge on green and then run a quick smoke-check on the published site to ensure anchors from external guides still resolve. :thumbsup:
